notes.title: 2-Player Multiplayer Content Development Note
notes.content:
[h3]2-Player Multiplayer Content Development Note[/h3]
The multiplayer system is almost complete, and i'm currently designing the content. Below is the content i'm working on. Feel free to suggest any ideas if you have any good ones!  

[h3]Two Game Modes[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Free Mode
[*]Duel Mode
[/olist]

[h3]Free Mode[/h3]
This mode allows players to enjoy a relaxed gameplay experience with a friend in the same environment as the single-player mode. You can see your friend’s screen and play together at your own pace.  
Even if you return to the title screen to change the game mode or skins, or if you restart after a game over, the server connection remains active. This ensures a continuous multiplayer experience without disconnections.  


[h3]Duel Mode[/h3]
This is a competitive mode where both players play under the same conditions.
Players can choose from special rule sets to compete:
[olist]
[*][b]Step/Sprint Rule[/b] (Choose one, tentative name)
[*][b]Interference Rule[/b] (Toggle on/off, tentative name)
[/olist]

[h3]Step Rule Duel[/h3]
If one player gets a game over, the remaining player wins if they have a higher score. If they have a lower score, the game continues without a time limit.
This rule allows for a relaxed score-based competition.

[h3]Sprint Rule Duel[/h3]
If one player gets a game over, the remaining player is given a time limit. If they fail to catch up to the opponent’s score within the time limit, they lose.  
This rule encourages fast-paced gameplay, similar to a racing game.

[h3]Interference Rule (Optional)[/h3]
This rule allows players to send ice blocks to their opponent based on combo streaks when merging animals.
[list]
[*]A [b]small ice block[/b] is sent at [b]2 combos[/b], and the ice size increases with higher combos.
[*]The ice shrinks gradually when animal merges happen nearby, and it disappears when it reaches a certain size.
[*]Players can also manually throw the ice block out of the game area.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes & Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Update[/h1]
[list]
[*]A new game option, 'Low Performance Mode,' has been added.
[i]Previously, it was automatically activated by detecting the game's FPS, but now players can manually set it.[/i]
[*]Tooltips have been added to the game over screen.
[i]Check out various game tips.[/i]
[*]New animal skins have been added to Sky Mode.
[olist]
[*]Hummingbird
[*]Daurian Redstart
[*]Goldcrest
[*]Sparrow
[*]Red Crossbill
[*]Crow
[/olist]
[*]The Toucan skin in Sky Mode has been remade.
[/list]

[h1]Announcement[/h1]
The full release plan for Animal Shake has been revised.
Initially, I planned to exit Early Access after adding Aqua Mode and various skins. However, I have decided to wait until an additional new content feature is completed.

Although the new content has not been finalized, I hope to include online 2-player multiplayer. I will share more details once the content is confirmed.

Thank you.

notes.title: Animal Shake development status preview (aqua mode, mobile version)
notes.content:
Hello, Animal Shake fans!

I am excited to share the progress on the upcoming Aqua Mode and the development of the mobile version.
[u]※It is still being developed, and it may be developed in a different direction from what I shared this time.[/u]

[h2]Aqua Mode[/h2]
Aqua Mode introduces aquatic animals, water, and buoyancy mechanics.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6ZdJdBO.gif[/img]
[i]※Currently playing with land animals as aquatic animals are still under development.[/i]
Animals in stages 1-5 float in the water, while animals in stage 6 and beyond sink to the bottom.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wi4istj.gif[/img]
[i]※A cat falls to push a deer, but due to the water pressure, it gets pushed back instead.[/i]
Aqua Mode offers a different kind of fun compared to land mode, with the enjoyment of calculating new mechanics and watching the water flow. I hope you look forward to it!

[h2]Mobile Version[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J5Ys4XH.gif[/img]
The mobile version will function similarly to the PC version, with touch controls replacing the mouse. Additionally, for devices with gyroscope sensors, you will be able to control the game by shaking or tilting the device, depending on the game settings.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
Animal Shake will transition from early access to official release once Aqua Mode is complete and various skins are added appropriately. Even after the official release, I will continue to update with new animals and boxes.

The mobile and Nintendo Switch versions are planned for release after the official release of the PC version of Animal Shake.

Thank you for your continued support, and I look forward to bringing you more exciting updates. Thank you.
